name: I Could Only See Her
source:
Here, you take the role of a blind-mute boy who encounters a girl wandering the streets. Somehow, he is able to see her silhouette, and will try to communicate with the girl while she devices a way for them to speak to each other. Time is short however, and they both must go their separate ways eventually.

[from [url=https://civilianghost.itch.io/i-could-only-see-her]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这里，你扮演一个盲哑男孩，遇到了一个在街上闲逛的女孩。不知何故，他能够看到她的轮廓，并会尝试与女孩交流，而她则为他们设计了一种彼此交谈的方式。然而时间很短，他们最终都必须分道扬镳。

[来自[url=https://civilianghost.itch.io/i-could-only-see-her]itch.io[/url]]
